title: When the Atlas Wakes
author: Petra Eriksen
blurb: Beatrix Crane, a widowed lighthouse keeper during the year of the great storms, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must finish the work while the workshop still stands before the century turns.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
